failure_contract: The recorded harness exits before writing a report when an initial response and its three identical warm requests differ after setting generated receipt_id, path_and_metadata_tokens, and total_response_tokens to common neutral values. It did not independently validate the original complete-response accounting.
current_harness_contract: The hardened harness exits when any response has inconsistent complete-response token accounting or when responses differ after removing receipt_id and recomputing exact receipt-free accounting to a fixed point.

resource_measurement.peak_process_rss_bytes: Maximum resident set size from /usr/bin/time -v around the complete harness process; this is independent of the end-of-run VmRSS recorded inside each raw report.
resource_measurement.elapsed_wall_seconds: Elapsed wall-clock time from /usr/bin/time -v around the complete harness process.
resource_measurement.host_pairing_limitation: No stable anonymized host fingerprint was retained for these attempts, so the recorded resource samples cannot establish same-host pairing.

attempts.reason: The report was written inside the harness worktree, so its own output made harness_worktree_dirty true.

Fragments, ordering, generation, source tokens, and omissions were identical; generated receipt identifiers changed path_and_metadata_tokens and total_response_tokens by one token. Commit a2625a699ec66318e225fa8a9836692e847f3e20 normalizes those two receipt-derived fields with receipt_id.
Three unrelated user-owned untracked files made the primary worktree dirty; they were preserved and subsequent evaluation moved to a clean detached worktree.
